name: Name
defaultHint: Set the KEY to the env var name the process expects, for example GH_TOKEN. Choose a secret to resolve a stored value at run start. PAPERCLIP_* variables are injected automatically.
userSecretsHint: User secrets resolve from the user responsible for the run. Required bindings fail until that user sets their value under Secrets → My secrets.
textHelp: Store the value inline as plain text.
organizationSecretHelp: Resolve a stored organization secret at run start.
userSecretHelp: Resolve the responsible user's own value at run start.
sensitiveHint: This value looks sensitive — store it as a secret
dismissHint: Dismiss — keep this value as plain text
invalidName: Invalid name — use letters, digits and _
reservedName: Reserved prefix — provided automatically and may be overridden
missingSecret: This secret no longer exists — runs will fail until you rebind.
disabledSecret: Runs will fail until re-enabled or rebound.
missingUserSecret: This user secret definition no longer exists — runs will fail until you rebind.
disabledUserSecret: Runs will fail until this user secret definition is re-enabled or rebound.
secretNameExists: A secret with this name already exists
storeDescription: Moves the typed value into an encrypted organization secret and binds <0>{{name}}</0> to it.
